# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 2 Slot 85: Late 4D Hegemons 0-Override Deepening & Anti-Hegemon Tension Cache (oe_heg2_, 0 vanilla/GUI overrides). Generated by gen_late_hegemons.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Proclaim Grande Armee Continental Hegemony Manifesto (颁行大军团大陆霸权宣言)
oe_heg2_dec_proclaim_mil_apex = {
	decision_category = government_decisions
	only_once = yes
	only_once_scope = country
	potential = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		NOT = { has_variable = oe_heg2_apex_mil_done }
		oe_heg2_can_use_mil_tools = yes
	}
	allow = {
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_heg2_player_only_tt
			is_ai = no
		}
		OR = {
			oe_heg2_mil_tier_at_least_2 = yes
			has_variable = oe_heg2_sim_multi_heg
		}
		gold >= 200
		prestige >= 25
	}
	ai_will_do = { value = 0 }
	illustration_tags = { 10 = interior }
	illustration_scope = {
		event_illustration_poptype_effect = {
			foreground = pop_type:soldiers
			background = pop_type:nobles
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = oe_heg2_dec_proclaim_mil_apex.a
		effect = {
			add_gold = -200
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_apex_mil_done value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = oe_heg2_apex_declared value = 1 }
			add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_apex_mil_mod years = 30 mode = replace }
			add_army_tradition = 15
			add_prestige = 20
			oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 10 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = oe_heg2.1
		}
	}
}
